_comment: Outcome of the 2026-10 discovery pass for inspected candidates. 'match' lists exact lower-case fragments of a candidate's DOI or URL (never a bare word of a title). A decision no harvested candidate matches is added to the inventory as a 'direct-search' candidate. inventory.py applies these as the candidate's status.

decisions.title: Canmore — National Record of the Historic Environment (points)
decisions.note: 174,054 records dated from ScAPA periods, centuries or years; undated generic records stay out of the index.

decisions.title: Archaeological Survey of Ireland — Sites and Monuments Record
decisions.note: 56,074 records; dated only where the monument class itself names a period (3,575).

decisions.title: Rejestr zabytków nieruchomych (NID, dane.gov.pl)

decisions.title: Estonia (register.muinas.ee) and Lithuania (kvr.kpd.lt) heritage registers

decisions.note: Public in the catalogue but Harvard returns 429 to this machine; licence is non-commercial academic → private pack once downloaded.

decisions.title: World Historical Gazetteer contributed datasets (e.g. List of Russian towns late 14c, Benjamin of Tudela, Heritage Gazetteer of Libya)

decisions.title: Public georeferenced historical maps (Harvard Geospatial Library and other OpenGeoMetadata catalogues)

decisions.title: Arkas 2.0 — archaeological sites of Slovenia (ZRC SAZU)
decisions.note: Each site's own dating in years (Leto_od/Leto_do); 3,684 sites in 1–1914.

decisions.title: Database of northeastern African archaeological and heritage sites (Marmarica)
decisions.note: 3,355 sites but 3,214 'Undetermined'; the ~190 dated ones carry only named periods without years.

decisions.title: Slovakia: Atlas of the Landscape monuments layers (SAŽP WFS)
decisions.note: Points with category only — no names, no dates.

decisions.title: ARIADNE portal — European archaeology catalogue (records with PeriodO-linked periods)
decisions.region: Iceland, Hungary, Finland, Austria, Germany, Bulgaria, Portugal and others
decisions.note: Harvested per country (API: 50/page, 10,000/query). Hungary, above the window, harvested by one text query per GeoNames municipality/town name (8,855 names in 3 resumable slices; completed 2026-10-01). Each phase keeps its own period; records without a point placed at their municipality only when the name is unique (2,638 left out). 63,354 dated records in the pack. Provider licences vary (e.g. Ísleif CC BY-NC-ND) → private pack.

decisions.title: Atlas of the Latin Church in the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth c. 1772 (IHGK Lublin)
decisions.note: 7,715 churches and 1,327 religious houses as a 1772 snapshot; EPSG:3857 coordinates converted; CC BY-NC → private pack.

decisions.title: Archaeological sites of wine and olive oil production in Hispania (CSUC Dataverse)
decisions.note: CSUC Dataverse answers with an Anubis bot wall from this machine. Retry from a browser.

decisions.title: Historical Urban Population 3700 BC – AD 2000 (Reba, Reitsma & Seto; Harvard Dataverse copy)
decisions.note: CC BY, but the download requires a guestbook response (name, email); not submitted without the user's consent. SEDAC copy needs an Earthdata login.

decisions.title: Stadestér 1.0 — global database of 41,000+ cities
decisions.note: Rejected: populations cubic-spline interpolated to annual values — manufactured precision, not source estimates.

decisions.title: Mid-19th-century building structures in Galicia and Austrian Silesia (Second Military Survey)
decisions.note: 1.3 M individual building points (c. 1850s survey), not named places — queued for a building-density layer.

decisions.title: Archaeological sites in the Trajan's Gate Pass, Bulgaria
decisions.note: Inspected 2026-10-01 (tgp.zip, CC BY 4.0, kept in the raw vault): 15 sites (inns, villages, a fortress) dated by century, several marked uncertain (?), plus an undated Ottoman road trace Ihtiman–Plovdiv. Too small to change any coverage cell; not integrated for now.

decisions.title: AMCR — Archaeological Map of the Czech Republic (Archeologický informační systém ČR)
decisions.note: Found by the automated investigation (92 of its document records surfaced as candidates). Open OAI-PMH API, CC BY-NC 4.0 → private pack. 11,042 sites and 236,259 fieldwork events, each split into components with an AMCR period whose years come from its PeriodO-linked vocabulary (e.g. Early Middle Hillfort Period 801–850); 268,599 spatial units (PIAN) with geometry; 18,376 individual finds. Harvest started 2026-10-01 (fetch_oai.py, resumable). Harvest completed 2026-10-01: 69,860 dated phases (private pack); 34,305 restricted records and 184,788 negative units left out.

decisions.title: A database for Spondylus gaederopus during the Neolithic of Europe
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: Neolithic artefact finds only — outside 1–1914.

decisions.title: Mapping smallpox cases and vaccination efforts in New South Wales
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: New South Wales, Australia (matched "Wales" in metadata).

decisions.title: Thailand Canonical Administrative-Names Reference
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: Outside the atlas area.

decisions.title: Villages to empire (Assyrian governance)
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: Northern Mesopotamia, Iron Age — outside the atlas area.

decisions.title: Where Went UK Churches: converted churches
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: Dates are modern conversion years, not the churches' history.

decisions.title: N Italy Zooarchaeological Dataset
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: Bronze Age faunal assemblages — outside 1–1914.

decisions.title: Historical Place Gazetteer and Historical Mine Register, Tyrol (duplicate of integrated)
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: Already integrated (tyrolmine).

decisions.title: Ottoman NFS gazetteer population file (duplicate of integrated)
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: Already integrated (ottomannfs).

decisions.title: Bosworth Islamic Dynasties (Islamic Civilization Atlas Dataset) — same data as the Islamic History Atlas v7.5
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: Same table as Atlas of Islamic History v7.5.0.0 (zenodo.19183844).

decisions.title: İslam Tarih Atlası / Atlas of Islamic History (v7.x)
decisions.note: Data inspected 2026-10-01: a derived web-app compilation. Its Yāqūt layer is geocoded by an AI model ("enriched via Claude API"), narratives are AI-completed, and its mint list mixes ancient and modern mints (e.g. Greek Haluntium, modern A Coruña) under "Islamic mints". Not used as a source; its underlying sources are followed instead (Bosworth, Nomisma, Hamburg Islamic Coin Corpus, al-Thurayyā — the last already integrated).

decisions.title: Hamburg Islamic Coin Corpus (HICC) — dated emissions per mint
decisions.note: Lead from the discovery chain of the Islamic History Atlas: coins with mint and year would date each mint's activity from emissions. Not yet inspected.

decisions.title: Nomisma.org mints (linked open data, CC BY)
decisions.note: Lead from the same chain: mint places with coordinates and identifiers; dating would come from coin corpora (OCRE, CRRO, HICC). Not yet inspected.

decisions.title: Zbiva, Early Medieval Data Set for the Eastern Alps (subset)
decisions.note: 1,104 sites via spec (generic loader): own earliest–latest dates, dating method and confidence kept; names as published (Š/Č/Ž lost in the source files, not restored by guess). Chain lead: the full online Zbiva database (zbiva.zrc-sazu.si).

decisions.title: VIA-TARIQ: Medieval road system in the Levant (roads and sites)
decisions.note: 2,372 road segments drawn per period (650–950, 950–1250, 1250–1350, 1350–1517) with certainty; 1,065 sites with own dates (9999 = unknown/continuing kept open), else the period of the map they are in.

decisions.title: Egypt Exploration Society Delta Survey sites
decisions.note: 782 sites (current ArcGIS layer snapshot); periods → years by standard Egyptian chronology stated in each label; private pack (reuse needs EES permission).

decisions.title: Mapping Jewish Communities of the Byzantine Empire
decisions.note: 176 attested phases from dated evidence joined to the gazetteer; island-level evidence placed at the island (approximate); 33 evidence rows the source could not locate left out.

decisions.title: Gobolitide (al-Jibal) microregion settlement dataset
decisions.note: 900 dated site phases; periods → years by the standard Jordanian (MEGA-Jordan) scheme, stated in labels.

decisions.title: Place-names in the Saga of the Earls of Orkney (Nottingham, 2025)
decisions.note: 92 names shown from their earliest saga-manuscript attestation (first attestation ≠ founding); no licence stated → private pack.

decisions.title: MobileGIS in archaeological prospection in Tunisia (MR3)
decisions.note: Survey of finds inside one rural site — not atlas-scale.

decisions.title: HMAP Dataset 19: Pärnu City Customs Records
decisions.note: Customs time series for one port (Pärnu); no further places.

decisions.title: Zbiva full database (zbiva.zrc-sazu.si) — sites, graves, artefacts
decisions.note: Chain lead from the Zbiva subset (integrated). 2026-10-01: the host resets the TLS connection from this machine (curl error 35, http and https). Retry from another network or ask ZRC SAZU for an export; the published subset is in use meanwhile.

decisions.title: INHILLDAUGAR: annotated place-names along the Daugava (Latvia)
decisions.note: 516 of 10,098 names carry a documented attestation century (13th–19th c.; sources such as the 1557 register, Mellin 1798) and are shown from it as first attestations; the rest (linguistic "early/late" only, or unclear) stay undated.

decisions.title: Woodlands of Antiquity: dendroarchaeological dataset
decisions.note: 592 site phases from 3,392 exact felling dates; 13,058 post-quem and 3,947 interval dates not used (no construction year).

decisions.title: Historical GIS and Guidebooks: Czechoslovak Tourist Attractions
decisions.note: A 1928 guidebook — after the atlas period (≤1914).

decisions.title: AIDA Archive of Italian radiocarbon dates
decisions.note: Overwhelmingly prehistoric radiocarbon samples.

decisions.title: Energy consumption dataset (year built)
decisions.note: Modern buildings energy certificates.

decisions.title: Historical Atlas of the Low Countries (1350–1800), DataverseNL

decisions.title: Arab conquest of the Maghreb (ArcGIS events)
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: 29 dated campaign events 643–710s; small; queued for an events spec.

decisions.title: Early Medieval Belfast (ArcGIS)
decisions.note: Automated investigation 2026-10-01, reviewed: 205 sites with period label "Early Medieval (c.500–c.1100)"; queued.

decisions.title: Strucke C14 Sweden

decisions.title: Greek migration / diaspora maps (ArcGIS)

decisions.title: HMAP Russian herring

decisions.title: Fortresses between Damascus and Medina (Hajj route; after Petersen)

decisions.title: Georeferenced database of Medieval military and religious sites in Northern Italy

decisions.title: Historic Civil Parishes of Wales (OS 1st/2nd edition, ArcGIS)

decisions.title: Hillforts in Latvia along Daugava (Nakala)
